objective: Seek restricted project funding for an MIT-licensed offline source-to-claim provenance verifier without presenting a grant application as customer revenue.

program.name: Hacker Initiative 2026 Grant Cycle: Signal/Noise
limits: One application per project per cycle
The application must be submitted through the English online form
An application may advance to a remote presentation
Awarded funding may be less than requested
Recipients owe project and budget reports
The applicant is responsible for lawful USD receipt and tax compliance

portfolio_decision.reason: OpenHI has stronger public technical proof and a cleaner equipment need, but its paper names six authors and acknowledges prior HKU and Hong Kong RGC funding. Proofline is the only candidate currently safe for LazyingArt to represent without inventing authority or a funding boundary.
openhi_gate: Authority to represent the project and contributors is documented
The proposed phase and budget do not duplicate HKU or RGC-supported work
Purchased equipment ownership and post-grant use are explicit
Current itemized quotes support the requested equipment amount

project.name: Proofline: Offline Source-to-Claim Verification
fit: Runs offline and does not upload source files
Checks local SHA-256 hashes for source and derived artifacts
Checks transformation references and source-located evidence for verified claims
Keeps unverified and rejected claims distinct from verified claims
Produces a deterministic non-zero exit on broken evidence
project.claim_boundary: A passing manifest establishes internal evidence-chain consistency only; it does not prove source truth, rights, authorship, learning outcomes, customer results, or security certification.

allowability_inquiry.subject: 2026 grant budget allowability question
questions: Whether a fixed-scope independent security or accessibility review is allowable despite the salary exclusion
Whether small independent reproduction-tester stipends or accessibility reimbursements fit the form's Stipend/Expenses category
allowability_inquiry.delivery_evidence: The isolated project browser showed the exact recipient, subject, and bounded question before one send action. Gmail displayed Message sent, and the exact subject appeared once in Sent. Private screenshots remain ignored and mode 0600.
allowability_inquiry.boundary: A delivered question is not eligibility confirmation, an application, an award, funding, a customer lead, or revenue.

budget.item: Four diverse offline test kits, removable storage, and capture peripherals
Fixed-scope independent security, privacy, and accessibility reviews
budget.gate: Confirm that external fixed-scope review expense is allowable before submission

budget.item: Small tester stipends and accessibility reimbursements
budget.gate: Confirm that the Stipend/Expenses category permits independent reproduction testing without classifying it as excluded salary

budget.item: Shipping, adapters, media, and test consumables

excluded_costs: Books, films, videos, social media, or website production
Advertising, merchandise, fundraising, or general awareness work
private_fields_required: Responsible payee and physical mailing address
Alternate contact details and responsible parties
application.submission_gate: First obtain the funder's allowability answer and replace provisional costs with itemized current quotes. Then review the exact entity, tax recipient, budget, eligibility, contact fields, and agreements in the visible form before submitting.

additional_outreach.purpose: Clarify fixed-scope independent review and tester-cost allowability before deciding whether the provisional Proofline budget is valid.

funnel.policy: Restricted project funding remains separate from customer revenue. An application, invitation, award notice, pending check, or click is not received money.
